reviews.review:
Solid game with decent gameplay. It has that Gears of War feel to it but is different enough to not feel like shallow clone.
The only downside is that there was suppose to be two other games but those got cancelled due to THQ having problems. 
So this is an incomplete story and it leaves off with the plot to be picked up in the sequels that haven't been made. Maybe Sega might green light those sequels but don't hold your breath. Otherwise buy this game and play it.

Bought this game for a buck and I am not disappointed. Even though it is an old game there is alot to enjoy. The graphics still look good and the environment makes you feel like a war is going on. The story is decent and there are alot of clues along the way that establish what is going on and why. The best vilian was the Ork war boss by far, the Caos element felt like it was tacked on and there was not much interaction or progression to it. 

The controls were a bit sluggish and hard to deal with at times on mouse and keyboard. I would recommend using a game controller instead. Sometimes the objective was not clear and I had no idea on where to go, or what to do. The Ork boss fight was annoying for the fact you are in a small enclosed space with a guy that likes to pin and does alot of melee damage. 

It is short enough to still make it enjoyable with my first playthrough taking under seven hours. Overall its not bad and is fun for a bit or if you have friends who can play with you. Combat is decent but the controls are sluggish. The game looks good enough for its age and the story works but definitely needs some polish.

Mouse control is atrocious, so is gamepad control. Look sensitivity changes depending on the depth that the reticle is focused on, making aiming nearly impossible. Lame unskippable cutscenes.

What other franchise has SO MANY GAMES that are SO AWFUL?  Only Warhammer as far as I know.

I hate this game. Just idling for cards.

Technically, mostly competent but thoroughly mediocre and incredibly bland 3rd person shooter/melee game. 

I love W40k, still can't recommend this. Gameplay is duller than toast, it feels like you're playing horde mode in gears of war half the time, the level design is  like an arena or an open room for half the game. Killed orks? Great kill a few hundred more. No cover shooting mechanics either, which I'm OK with, but it doesn't help the pace of the game much.

I love w40k, got this on sale for like $1 or something on HB a while ago and still couldn't bring myself to finish this.

Not recommended.
